summary: reactjs-risk preinstall exfiltrates username and hostname via DNS to canarytokens.com
details: The package's preinstall script runs unconditionally on `npm install` and collects the installer's username (via `whoami` executed through child_process and `os.userInfo`) and hostname, hex-encodes them, and issues a DNS A-record lookup to `<hex>.srikgkxksgzu6kif36cq6rwp0.canarytokens.com`, causing installer host/user identifiers to leak to the operator of that canarytoken on every install. The script deliberately obfuscates the APIs it uses: module names `dns`, `os`, `child_process`, and the `whoami` command are assembled by string concatenation (`'d'+'n'+'s'`, `'child_'+'process'`, `'wh'+'oa'+'mi'`), with in-source comments stating the intent to disguise these names from automated scanners. The destination is a hardcoded external host the installer did not opt into and is unrelated to any documented package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
